product_purpose: Consume exactly one owned 1K Food item from canonical Home.

state_transitions.notes: The source is a fresh native verified Home frame.

state_transitions.via: settled selected Resource & Speedup successor, with one optional current-frame-bound category tab tap when another Bag tab is current
state_transitions.notes: Skip the tab tap when Resource & Speedup is already visually selected; Android Back is not used.

state_transitions.via: zero to six current-frame-bound content-aware forward or reverse swipes in a central list-content lane
state_transitions.notes: Forward reveals lower rows; reverse reveals upper rows when lower-resource or larger Food markers are visible. Each swipe must change the stable list/OCR signature; stall, repeat, or unknown stops before another swipe.

state_transitions.via: fresh exact 1K Food row and measured-card ownership recognition after each scroll
state_transitions.notes: AP, Stamina, premium, bulk selection, and unidentified targets are rejected.

state_transitions.via: one current-frame-bound Use control at quantity one
state_transitions.notes: A second Use, confirmation, or quantity action fails closed.

state_transitions.via: exact owned-count decrement of one for the measured 1K Food item
state_transitions.notes: Transport success alone is not completion; Food-resource increase is not accepted as substitute proof.

permitted_inputs: optional current-frame-bound Resource & Speedup category tab when another Bag tab is selected
settled current Resource & Speedup Bag successor
current-frame-bound content-aware forward/reverse Resource list scrolling, at most six progressing swipes
one current-frame-bound 1K Food Use at quantity one

navigation_input_authorization.notes: The direct route is Bag, optional Resources-tab select, zero to six progressing content-aware list swipes, one Use, and visible Home return.

local_postconditions: verified Home is the source state
settled Resource & Speedup successor is positively recognized after zero or one category tab tap
each dispatched list swipe is bound to the current overlay-free central lane and materially changes its stable signature
owned 1K Food quantity is at least one
the 1K Food anchor, owned count, quantity-one evidence, and exactly one Use ROI are fully inside one measured current-frame Resources card
exactly one daily-resource-item:use-1k-food event is dispatched
owned 1K Food count decreases by exactly one
verified Home is the terminal state

cost_quantity_requirements.notes: One owned 1K Food item only; no premium substitution, recovery item, bulk action, or second confirmation.

cooldown_deferred_behavior: If the exact item, quantity, successor, or Home state is ambiguous, dispatch zero input and report evidence_required.
bounded_recovery_behavior: Fail closed on unknown Home, Bag, Resources, item, quantity, successor, overlay, or return control. Android Back is prohibited.
evidence_requirements: current-frame measured Resources card fully containing the exact 1K Food anchor, owned count, quantity-one evidence, and exactly one Use ROI
immediate-post exact owned-count decrement of one

replay_fixture_requirements.notes: Native consequential evidence is not fabricated by offline tests.

live_validation_scenarios.notes: Optional Resources-tab select, at most six progressing list swipes, and one supervised item-consumption event; scheduler eligibility remains disabled.
